order.title: File order
order.description: File IDs in the order to merge. The core passes inputs to the worker in this order, so the adapter itself never sees file IDs.

metadataFrom.title: Document properties from
metadataFrom.description: Index of the input (in merge order) whose title, author and other properties the result keeps, or -1 for none.

fileTitles.description: Bookmark title for each input, in merge order. Filled in by the core from the file names; not shown in the form.
